faq_heading: Burke Mountain houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Burke Mountain. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Burke Mountain, Coquitlam: 65 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 3 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Burke Mountain rose from 53 in June to 65 in September (+22.6%), and 37 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 15.3% of Coquitlam’s 425 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Burke Mountain?
Burke Mountain also had 77 condos and townhomes listed and 11 sold in September, against 65 houses listed. The Burke Mountain condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Burke Mountain home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

58 houses sold in Burke Mountain with a median price of $1,954,000 (the middle half sold between $1,770,625 and $2,158,750), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 96.3% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $525 per square foot, a median year built of 2014 and a median lot of 5,042 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Burke Mountain?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 65 houses listed in Burke Mountain. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Burke Mountain a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Burke Mountain had a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Burke Mountain from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 37 houses sold in Burke Mountain over those 4 months, out of 219 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Burke Mountain?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Burke Mountain sell for?
faq.a: 58 houses sold in Burke Mountain between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,954,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Burke Mountain?
faq.a: The median was 25 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.3% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
